description: Deterministic sklearn multioutput response-method bookkeeping helpers.

nodes.name: response_method_candidates
nodes.description: Normalize sklearn response_method or chain_method input into an ordered tuple of candidate method names.

nodes.name: response_method_name
nodes.description: Select sklearn's first implemented response method from an ordered candidate tuple and a supplied implemented-method set.
nodes.type_signature: (method_candidates: tuple[str, ...], implemented_methods: tuple[str, ...], *, estimator_name: str) -> str

nodes.name: chain_fit_chain_method_name
nodes.description: Resolve the chain_method name sklearn stores for ClassifierChain during fit from an ordered method specification and supplied implemented methods.
nodes.type_signature: (chain_method: str | tuple[str, ...], implemented_methods: tuple[str, ...], *, estimator_name: str) -> str

nodes.name: multioutput_predict_proba_available_from_estimators
nodes.description: Require all fitted sub-estimators to expose predict_proba before MultiOutputClassifier predict_proba proceeds.

nodes.name: multioutput_predict_proba_available_from_base_estimator
nodes.description: Require the unfitted base estimator to expose predict_proba before MultiOutputClassifier exposes predict_proba.
